opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aged 18 and over; UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences, including schools, public audiences and under-represented groups. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC); PhD students or researchers at any career stage, in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits and organising meetings/workshops.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or RSC members of at least three consecutive years if outside these countries; must incur additional caring expenses to attend a chemistry-related meeting/conference/workshop or professional development event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering additional costs incurred for care they usually provide. Continuously open with no stated deadline.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or RSC members of at least three consecutive years if outside these countries; must require support relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to reduce accessibility challenges when attending professional events, covering equipment, services or personal expenses associated with access needs. Continuously open with no stated deadline.
